name: Skelterbaan, Maisdoolhof Speelboerderij
evidence: The 202 m loop sits at the Maisdoolhof Speelboerderij play farm in Malden (OSM playground node within 200 m); the farm's own site lists a 'Skelterbaan' and 'Traptractorbaan' (pedal go-karts / pedal tractors for children), not a motorised kart track.

Four covered sport=karting raceway segments mapped in 2026 next to a fenced paintball pitch off a private service road (Zuidelijke Dwarsweg) by the A12 at Waddinxveen; no operator name in OSM and web searches found no karting business here.

Small concrete area tagged karting on the grounds of Zespół Szkół Ponadpodstawowych nr 1 (Limanowskiego 10, Bartoszyce), next to school pitches and the town pool; possibly a school manoeuvring/traffic-education pad, but no source found confirming its use.

Sports-centre polygon tagged karting at the foot of the Kotelnica Białczańska ski area next to chalets and Hotel Bania parking; no web source confirms a go-kart offer at this spot (nearby Bania Kids minipark is a children's park).
Asphalt sports-centre polygon tagged karting inside the Bolesławiec industrial zone (ul. Ekonomiczna / Modłowa, next to SRG Global and other factories); no karting business found for this location.

name: Centrum Aktywnego Wypoczynku Borek
evidence: The track lies inside the 'Centrum Aktywnego Wypoczynku Borek' recreation ground (Borek 302, gm. Rzezawa); the centre's own site lists go-kart rides ('przejażdżki gokartami') and the regional tourism portal mentions its go-kart track.

Lit sports-centre polygon tagged karting on the southern edge of Chojnice near an Orlen station, a hotel/conference hall with shooting range and TenisCamp courts; no karting operator found for this spot (the known 'Canpol Racing' track is in Człuchów).

Survey-mapped (2023) customer-access karting area beside a customer paintball field, shelter and parking in Jałowe (gm. Ustrzyki Dolne), suggesting a small leisure business; no web source found naming it or confirming karts.

Track lies at the Park Wola Sodowa family amusement park (Pychowice, Kraków); travel directories list a 'Tor gokartowy' landmark in Dębniki, but no park or operator source found describing karts, so it may be a children's ride.
Lit paved leisure=track tagged karting next to the OSK MOTORISTA driving school and behind the M1 Marki mall; may be a driving-school manoeuvre yard, no karting source found.
Pitch multipolygon tagged karting in the centre of Rudnik nad Sanem beside the secondary-school complex (Technikum/LO); likely a school facility, but no source found describing it.
189 m raceway in the Rzeczka (gm. Walim) ski/holiday area beside the Sowia Grapa guest house, Ośrodek wypoczynkowy Rzeczka and a ski lift; no web source found confirming a kart offer here.

name: Gokarty (JuraPark Solec Kujawski)
evidence: The 159 m loop is a 'Gokarty' attraction inside the JuraPark Solec Kujawski dinosaur theme park (OSM node 12585618159); the park's own playground page only describes rides in 'mini samochodziki' (mini cars) for visiting children, i.e. a children's amusement ride rather than a kart track.

711 m asphalt raceway described in OSM as 'Tor Kartingowy w Suwałkach' (tagged karting;motor;motocross) beside the Zespół Szkół nr 6 vocational school; no current operator, club or event source found, and the school site does not mention karting.

240 m raceway inside the former Elana industrial site (Boryszew S.A. Oddział Elana, Toruń-Rubinkowo); no karting business found here (Toruń's known kart venue, MotoPark Toruń, is on the other side of the city at ul. Łukasiewicza).
Sports-centre polygon tagged karting by the school (Samorządowe Centrum Edukacji Szkolnej) and the stadium in Tylicz; probably a school/municipal sports area, no source found confirming kart use.

Small asphalt sports-centre polygon tagged karting among public fitness stations and pitches next to the Albatros pool and Hasanka playground in Warszawa-Ursus (Niedźwiadek); likely a small public play/traffic area, but no source found.

name: Tor kartingowy (Jurajski Park Dinozaurów)
evidence: The loop lies inside the Jurajski Park Dinozaurów children's amusement park at Wasilków, mapped as a playground called 'Tor kartingowy'; the park's current ride list has no karting, only an autodrom (bumper cars) and a children's 'Miasteczko Ruchu Drogowego' (traffic town).

name: Camping Tumiany pedal-kart area
evidence: The asphalt area is inside Camping Tumiany (Ośrodek Wypoczynkowy Camping Tumiany); the campsite's site only mentions rules for pedal go-karts ('Regulamin gokartów na pedały'), not motorised karts.

Point tagged karting among playgrounds and the 'Indoorspielplatz' of the Polenmarkt Hohenwutzen border market (Osinów Dolny); the market's own pages list only children's pedal vehicles (ages 1.5-8) and coin-operated E-Autos, no kart track, so it is probably a children's ride but this is not confirmed.

name: Gokarty Zaurolandia
evidence: The 615 m asphalt, fee=yes track adjoins the Zaurolandia dinosaur/family park at Rogowo (OSM theme_park way 822998054); the park's own site lists 'gokarty' among attractions and its price list charges 'Gokardy - 20 zł/os.' separately from admission. Kart type (adult/child) is not stated.

411 m raceway in Byxelkrok (northern Öland), mapped since 2012 with no name; no karting business found here. The only nearby kart venue found, Glabo Gokart & Paintball, is at Glabo near Löttorp about 13 km south, so it is not this spot.
Asphalt leisure=track area tagged karting at Dansut, Gnesta, next to a sport=motor track area and parking; no club or operator found online.

466 m kart raceway right next to the Kinnekulle Ring circuit (Husaby, Götene); OSM gives contact:website hyrgokart.nu, but that domain no longer resolves and neither the Kinnekulle Ring site nor tourism pages mention kart rental, so current status is unknown.

Point tagged karting next to a bowling node at the Cyberzone activity centre on Saltö, Karlskrona; Cyberzone's current site lists bowling, lasergame, arcade etc. but no go-karting, so any kart offer may have been discontinued.

Pitch tagged karting on Risövägen (Remslemon), the street of Sollefteå Camping; a Höga Kusten tourism page says the campsite offers 'large go-karts for older children and adults', but the municipality's campsite pages do not describe them, so they may be pedal karts.

Polygon tagged leisure=stadium + karting in the Himmelstalund park area near Himmelstalunds camping and the Borg pitches, Norrköping; no karting club or business found for it (Raceland Gokart is about 6 km east at Berga, GokartArenan at Klinga).

name: GokartArenan
evidence: The 776 m track is on Horns väg (Klinga/Löt, 605 97), matching the address of 'GokartArenan, Horns väg 5', which a city guide describes as indoor and outdoor go-karting with booking; but its own site gokartarenan.se now shows 'Squarespace - Website Expired', so current operation is unconfirmed.
Pitch tagged karting beside the E20 at Lida/Läggesta (Strängnäs kommun) with no surrounding named features; no karting venue found for the area.
397 m raceway in woodland at Fresta/Bollstanäs (Upplands Väsby) surrounded by several unnamed leisure=track ways and an archery field; no club or operator found.

Recreation ground tagged karting at Malmasågen, Hökåsen (Västerås) inside a motor area with several folkrace raceways and a karting raceway (way 175854753); SMK Västerås Karting's postal address is Pinnmovägen, Hökåsen, but its mapped kart track is at Hälla ring (about 5 km away), so the club's use of this site is not confirmed.
292 m raceway off Argongatan beside Boglundsängen nature reserve and a fenced Armed Forces (FMTIS) area in Örebro; no karting club or venue found for it.
Point tagged karting among playgrounds, a multiarena and adventure golf at the Gustavsvik resort/camping (Örebro); no source found describing karts there, so it may be a children's pedal-car area.
